scope: Bounded conditional thermal station family at fixed pulse rate and radius. 60% package conversion is the working premise; higher efficiencies and apparatus ratings are explicit scenarios. No global optimum or demonstrated plant is claimed.
environment_reference: Zero direct sunlight. Explicit11.0254 W/m² absorbed IR per full sphere is a gray compact Solar-IR benchmark, not a measured local sky. Zero-IR rows are optimistic controls.
hardware_scope: Original generic service, source, storage and insulation allocations retained. Thermal converter replaces the old gross-electric converter allocation. HX and optional extra pump hardware are incremental. Factory mass scales with repaired throughput independently of its electricity cost.

additional_internal_UA_source.meaning: Recuperator plus generator-cooling conductance from independent conditional six-stage gas-cycle cases is added to the optimized external-exchanger minimum. The 220 K and 70% cases are temperature/conductance requirements, not complete matching solved gas cycles.
